liebermann.laws: Hn, Wl art Lond retr, Wl lad, CHn cor, Hn mon, Hn com
liebermann.notes: Copied c. 1252, often faultily, from Sc after its correction: ff. 5–14 Hn, then [M]yrcheneland, Constitucio domus regie and the Dialogus de Scaccario; in another hand f. 99 Wl art Lond retr, Wl lad, CHn cor, f. 100 Hn mon, Hn com.

entries.text_de:
British Museum Hargrave 3133, um 1252 oft fehlerhaft copirt aus Sc, nach dessen Corrigirung, f. 5—14 Hn, s. u. S. 547; f. 15 (wie Sc f. 29d. 30) in derselben Hand [M]yrcheneland und Constitucio domus regie4; f. 16 Dialogus de Scaccario5, wovon die Hn vorangehenden Folien das erste Stück enthalten . . . .

In anderer Hand als Hn: f. 99 Wl art Lond retr, u. S. 489; Wl lad, u. S. 483; CHn cor, u. S. 521; f. 100 Hn mon, u. S. 523; Hn com, u. S. 5246.
entries.text_en:
British Museum Hargrave 3133, c. 1252, often faultily copied from Sc, after its correction, ff. 5—14 Hn, see below, p. 547; f. 15 (as Sc f. 29d. 30) in the same hand [M]yrcheneland and Constitucio domus regie4; f. 16 Dialogus de Scaccario5, of which the folios preceding Hn contain the first part . . . .

In a different hand from Hn: f. 99 Wl art Lond retr, below, p. 489; Wl lad, below, p. 483; CHn cor, below, p. 521; f. 100 Hn mon, below, p. 523; Hn com, below, p. 5246.

notes.text_de: vgl. Hall Red book of the Exchequer I p. l. Dort und Neu. Archiv für Gesch. X 594 über sonstigen Inhalt.
notes.text_en: cf. Hall, Red book of the Exchequer I p. l. There and in Neu. Archiv für Gesch. X 594 on the other contents.

notes.text_de: Hall p. lxxxvi f. 807; meine Leges Angl. Lond. S. 7.
notes.text_en: Hall p. lxxxvi f. 807; my Leges Angl. Lond. p. 7.

notes.text_de: ed. Hughes, Crump and Johnson p. 3: auch dies aus Sc copirt.
notes.text_en: ed. Hughes, Crump and Johnson p. 3: this too copied from Sc.

transcription.doubts: 'nach' is letter-spaced for emphasis. Note 3 'p. l' (small-caps roman 50). The 'Hn' in 'die Hn vorangehenden Folien' and 'als Hn' is roman.
